# House Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs everything at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, and that starts only with skills made by Skill Harbor itself.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what you want to do, in normal words. No jargon needed. 2. It does a quick check of what that need really means, and whether a house skill çan cover it. 3. It searches Skill Harbor, filtered to the house seller only, for skills that fit that need. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It reads the full description of each çandidate, compares it to your need, and shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, one fit for your çase, one limit for your çase, its price, its API need, its verifiçation status, and what was not vérifiéd. It never declares a single best skill, and it never guesses from a title alone. You choose from the list. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, uses those skills step by step, and then summarizes the result in plain words, with clear next steps.
